sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Am]To the minds of all who've Never seen or heard.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Am]Where mankind is wanting, fill the vacant [C]place.
[Am]Be the means through which the Lord reveals His grace.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Dm]Add to your believing deeds that [F]prove it [Am]true,
[Am]Follow in His footsteps, go where He [C]has trod;
[Am]In the world's great trouble risk yourself for God.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: [Dm]Let your heart be tender and your [F]vision [Am]clear;
[Dm]See mankind [F]as God sees, serve Him far [Gm]and near.
[Am]Let your heart be broken by a brother's [C]pain;
[Am]Share your rich resources, give and give again.
